proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto versions 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 have a memory leak that can be exploited remotely due to mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function when clients send many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs.

AV.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the memory leak in affected versions of Eclipse Mosquitto.

evidence_quotes.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs
